title: rosa canina subsp. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa canina subsp. obtusifolia, commonly known as Dwarf Wild Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina species, a type of rose bush that is native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. The Dwarf Wild Rose is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subsp. obtusifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which can be beneficial in treating wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
